## Issues

An audit refuted three of my published claims; I reproduced each at HEAD before accepting (`2ee4c9b88c`).

The one that matters: **I landed a false refutation.** After first publishing a too-weak limit, I over-corrected into `not_reachable_of_straddling`, asserting the no-go blocks the widened route. It does not — the no-go quantifies over `DivisorAdaptation` while the widened route consumes `AffAdaptation`, and `isCertified_affine_and_not_isCertified_chart` proves the opposite conjunction on those divisors, making the no-go evidence *for* the widened side. Deleted, not caveated (it was also a verbatim restatement of a lemma in its own import closure, with an unused hypothesis). Over-correcting a hedge into a refutation is worse than the hedge: it forecloses a lane's attempt.
